relics.name: Stolen Heirloom
relics.desc: A family's keepsake, scratched where the thief pried out a stone and thought better of it.

relics.name: Rumored Relic
relics.desc: Old, heavy and humming faintly. Whoever wanted it wanted it badly.

relics.name: Rare Reagents
relics.desc: A bundle of roots, caps and petals, wrapped in damp cloth so they keep.

relics.name: Daedra Heart
relics.desc: Still warm. Still, faintly, beating. It will not keep forever.

relics.name: Salvaged Strongbox
relics.desc: A lockbox from a wreck, swollen with water and sealed with somebody's crest.

relics.name: Smuggler's Ledger
relics.desc: Names, dates and debts in a cramped hand. Several of the names are important.

relics.name: Forbidden Tome
relics.desc: Its clasp is shaped like a closed eye. The pages are warmer than they should be.

relics.name: Captive's Token
relics.desc: Something the captive pressed into your hand so their family would know you.
